name: RapidTriage core forensics #71-#80 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #71 parser crash isolation fixture assertions

required_assertions: Parser failures preserve isolated parser_errors, failed parser JSON output, run continuation warnings, summary counts, trusted crash-corpus diff status, and #71 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; native process sandboxing, trusted crash-corpus manifests, and corrupt-input fuzz corpus remain blockers.

datasets.name: #72 memory cap fixture assertions

required_assertions: Run summaries preserve memory cap configuration, RSS readings, stage-boundary enforcement, fail-fast warnings, hard-limit caveats, trusted RSS diff status, and #72 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; hard OS memory controls, trusted RSS manifests, and platform RSS validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #73 preview sandbox fixture assertions

required_assertions: Source previews preserve read-only bounded preview metadata, active-content blocking, no network execution, cap metadata, OS sandbox warning, trusted no-exec diff status, and #73 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; renderer/codecs/macros and trusted no-exec preview manifests still require external sandbox validation.

datasets.name: #74 large SQLite/FTS fixture assertions

required_assertions: SQLite outputs preserve performance pragmas, table profiles, searchable text column counts, bounded row previews, large-corpus warnings, trusted query-plan diff status, and #74 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; trusted query-plan manifests, 10M-row query-plan, and WAL/deleted-row validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #75 parallel parser scheduler fixture assertions

required_assertions: Run summaries preserve bounded worker count, deterministic outputs, per-parser capture, resume-aware scheduling, local-threadpool warning, trusted scheduler diff status, and #75 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; trusted scheduler manifests, distributed scheduling, and TB-scale backpressure validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #76 file hash cache fixture assertions

required_assertions: Hash outputs preserve MD5/SHA1/SHA256, path-size-mtime cache metadata, hit/miss counters, hash-cache assessment, persistent-cache warning, and #76 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; persistent content-addressed cache and large-case hit-ratio validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #77 duplicate detection fixture assertions

required_assertions: File scans preserve same-size bucketing, bounded SHA256 confirmation, duplicate group counts, representative paths, suppression warnings, and #77 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; fuzzy/media duplicate validation and analyst suppression UX remain blockers.

datasets.name: #78 cursor pagination fixture assertions

required_assertions: API pages preserve cursor tokens, offset/limit/total metadata, next/previous cursors, bounded rows, snapshot warning, and #78 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; snapshot-isolated cursors and endpoint-wide pagination compatibility remain blockers.

datasets.name: #79 UI virtualization fixture assertions

required_assertions: API pagination and web UI preserve bounded DOM row windows, visible-row disclosure, keyboard/filter flow, API pagination links, virtual-scroller warning, and #79 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; true virtual scroller, viewport persistence, and browser e2e performance evidence remain blockers.

datasets.name: #80 cancellation/retry fixture assertions

required_assertions: Job payloads preserve queued cancellation, running cancel request records, failed/canceled retry support, persisted cancel flags, partial-output warnings, and #80 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; parser-level cancellation under load and partial-output cleanup/resume validation remain blockers.
